Description
The stunningly created PAMP Suisse 10 gram Romanesque Cross Gold Bar is produced in Switzerland and comprises 10 grams .9999 high-quality gold. The Romanesque Cross Bar is one of five bars released in the PAMP Gold Series, with each one designed with a unique theme of various icons, religious figures, and icons.
Romanesque Cross is the most well-known symbol of Christian faith and hope; however, it was also used to symbolize unimaginable punishment and torture. Since the 2nd century AD, this Romanesque Cross has been associated with the Christian faith in both positive and negative ways.
PAMP Suisse
is considered the world’s precious metal platform to mint the most prestigious mints globally. The Romanesque Cross is regarded as a symbol of the Christian faith. The Romanesque Cross PAMP Suisse 10 gram Gold Bar is a beautiful depiction of ancient religious symbols. This beautiful gold bar is available to purchase at Bullion Trading LLC.
Design of PAMP Suisse 10 gram Gold Bar – Romanesque Cross
The obverse side of PAMP Suisse 10 Gram Romanesque Cross Gold Bar depicts the ornate Romanesque Cross. Created in the Latin cross and with uniform arms, the image has smaller crosses at every one of four ends on the arms. Light rays radiating from the bottom of the cross represent holiness.
On the Reverse of PAMP Suisse 10-gram gold Bar is a Romanesque Cross, The Pamp Suisse logo is shown on the bar’s top that includes four initials PAMP in a tiny circle with Suisse beneath. Below the PAMP Suisse logo, the weight i.e 1 ounce, and the quality of the gold bar i.e 999.9 are written. In the lower part of the Gold Bar, the assayer’s stamp and the specific serial number of each bar are written. The serial numbers on the gold bars are comprised of a one-letter code with six numbers.
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse – 10 gram Romanesque Cross Gold Bar
Contains 10 gram of .9999 pure gold.
Manufactured by the PAMP Suisse.
It comes with an assay certificate.
Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
The obverse depicts a cross and a pedestal that appears as if it would have been at home in the medieval cathedral.
The reverse depicts the PAMP logo and the purity, weight, and stamp of the assayer.
Each bar is assigned a specific serial number.
